currentParagraphText: “Why wouldn’t it be?” Dina asked. “Nature doesn’t care what the landscape looks like. It adapts. Besides, the barrier ensured no creatures lived there before we started fighting, and I’m sure now that it’s dispelled, beasts that will be nourished by our remnant energies and Records will flock to it.”
